title: Advanced Topics in Computer Systems; Large Language Models, Security, and Privacy
description:
Must be in the Graduate Program in Computer Science. All other graduate students must request permission.

This course will cover advanced topics in Large Language Models (LLMs) for cybersecurity, as well as security and privacy issues of LLMs, with a focus on applications and risks of coding agents. We will explore topics including but not limited to agentic methods for security vulnerability detection and patching, securing coding agents, malicious agent skills, and privacy issues of coding agents.
